**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve plaintext vault behavior for existing oauth-flow users**

Defaulting `tokenStorageMode` to `"encrypted-required"` makes callbacks and refreshes fail with `OAUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_UNSAFE` whenever callers still pass a plain `TokenVault` (for example `authfn/core` creates `new DbAdapterTokenVault(...)` and does not set `tokenStorageMode`). Because this commit changes the default without migrating those consumers, existing OAuth sign-in paths can regress at runtime immediately after upgrading.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Accept void disconnect hooks for backward compatibility**

Rejecting non-object disconnect hook results now turns previously valid `onDisconnected` hooks into hard failures: hooks that only perform side effects and return `void` (as in existing authfn social OAuth code paths) now throw `VALIDATION_ERROR` during disconnect. This means disconnect can fail after local token cleanup solely because the hook omitted a structured return value, which is a breaking runtime regression introduced by this validation.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid async API break for scope policy enforcement**

Changing `validateScopes` from sync to async is a breaking API change that leaves existing synchronous call sites unenforced unless they are all updated. In this repo, `authfn/core` still calls `registry.validateScopes(...)` without `await`, so disallowed-scope checks no longer gate execution and failures can become unhandled promise rejections. This should be introduced in a backward-compatible way (or migrate all callers in the same change).

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

2\. Plaintext tokenvault breaks flows 🐞 Bug ✓ Correctness 
@superfunctions/oauth-flow now throws OAUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_UNSAFE when tokenVault is not an
EncryptedTokenVault unless tokenStorageMode is explicitly set to "plaintext-unsafe". Repo code
still constructs oauth-flow services with plaintext vaults (e.g., DbAdapterTokenVault,
MemoryTokenVault), so OAuth callback/refresh will fail (or always return null in the refresh
wrapper).
Agent Prompt ``` ### Issue description `createOAuthFlowService()` now rejects plaintext token persistence unless `tokenStorageMode: "plaintext-unsafe"` is explicitly set. Existing repo call sites still pass plaintext `TokenVault` implementations, causing OAuth callbacks/refresh to fail. ### Issue Context - `oauth-flow` now calls `assertTokenStorageIsSafe()` before persisting tokens for `handleCallback()` and `refresh()`. - Downstream modules in this repo still use `DbAdapterTokenVault` / `MemoryTokenVault` directly. ### Fix Focus Areas - Update persistent vault usages to `EncryptedTokenVault` (preferred): - authfn/core/src/plugins/social-oauth.ts[435-492] - For intentionally-plaintext, short-lived in-memory flows, explicitly opt in: - recfn/server/src/calendar/token-refresh.ts[40-90] - (Optional) Audit other `createOAuthFlowService` call sites for plaintext vaults. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools

3\. Unawaited async scope validation 🐞 Bug ✓ Correctness 
ProviderPolicyRegistry.validateScopes() was changed from sync to async, but
authfn/core/src/plugins/social-oauth.ts still calls it without await inside a non-async helper.
This will cause a TypeScript type error (or an unhandled rejected Promise at runtime) and prevents
scope validation/consent persistence from running deterministically.
Agent Prompt ``` ### Issue description `ProviderPolicyRegistry.validateScopes()` is now async, but authfn's `authorizeScopes()` calls it without `await` and returns synchronously. This breaks typechecking and can skip enforcement. ### Issue Context `validateScopes()` now persists a consent record via an async store write. Callers must `await` it (and likely become async themselves). ### Fix Focus Areas - Make `authorizeScopes()` async and `await registry.validateScopes(...)`: - authfn/core/src/plugins/social-oauth.ts[649-669] - Update call site to await the new async helper: - authfn/core/src/plugins/social-oauth.ts[168-173] ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
